headline: Uzbekistan and Turkey's OYAK Explore Joint Gas-Chemical Project in Bukhara
summary: Uzbek state authorities and Turkish industrial group OYAK discussed plans to construct a major gas-chemical production facility in Uzbekistan's Bukhara region and create joint industrial zones.
why: OYAK is one of Turkey's largest industrial conglomerates. Uzbekistan possesses extensive natural gas reserves used for domestic petrochemical processing.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Gas-chemical plant investments expand Uzbekistan's downstream industrial processing capability.
